title: सप्तनवत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Yaksha appears and puts a long series of riddling questions to Yudhishthira, on the sun, dharma, happiness, the greatest wonder and the true path, and Yudhishthira answers each one. Offered the life of one brother, he chooses Nakula so that both his mothers may have a living son, and the Yaksha, pleased by his fairness, restores all four.
summary.kn: ಯಕ್ಷನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷನಾಗಿ ಸೂರ್ಯ, ಧರ್ಮ, ಸುಖ, ಮಹದಾಶ್ಚರ್ಯ, ನಿಜಮಾರ್ಗಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಗಟಿನಂಥ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ದೀರ್ಘ ಸರಣಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಹೋದರನ ಜೀವ ನೀಡುವೆನೆಂದಾಗ ಇಬ್ಬರು ತಾಯಂದಿರಿಗೂ ಬದುಕಿರುವ ಮಗನಿರಲೆಂದು ನಕುಲನನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವನ ನ್ಯಾಯಬುದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿ ಯಕ್ಷನು ನಾಲ್ವರನ್ನೂ ಬದುಕಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: यक्ष प्रकट होकर युधिष्ठिर से सूर्य, धर्म, सुख, सबसे बड़े आश्चर्य और सच्चे मार्ग पर पहेलीनुमा प्रश्नों की लम्बी शृंखला पूछता है, और युधिष्ठिर हर एक का उत्तर देते हैं। एक भाई का जीवन देने का प्रस्ताव मिलने पर वे नकुल को चुनते हैं ताकि दोनों माताओं का एक-एक पुत्र जीवित रहे, और उनकी निष्पक्षता से प्रसन्न यक्ष चारों को जीवित कर देता है।
summary.te: యక్షుడు ప్రత్యక్షమై సూర్యుడు, ధర్మం, సుఖం, మహాశ్చర్యం, నిజమైన మార్గం గురించి పొడుపుకథల వంటి ప్రశ్నల సుదీర్ఘ పరంపరను అడుగుతాడు, యుధిష్ఠిరుడు ప్రతి దానికీ బదులిస్తాడు. ఒక సోదరుని ప్రాణం ఇస్తానని అనగా ఇద్దరు తల్లులకూ బ్రతికి ఉన్న కుమారుడు ఉండాలని నకులుని ఎంచుకుంటాడు; అతని న్యాయబుద్ధికి మెచ్చి యక్షుడు నలుగురినీ బ్రతికిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: யக்ஷன் தோன்றிச் சூரியன், அறம், இன்பம், மாபெரும் வியப்பு, உண்மையான வழி பற்றிய புதிர் போன்ற கேள்விகளின் நீண்ட தொடரை யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் கேட்க, அவர் ஒவ்வொன்றுக்கும் விடையளிக்கிறார். ஒரு சகோதரனின் உயிரைத் தருவதாகச் சொன்னதும் இரு அன்னையருக்கும் உயிருள்ள மகன் இருக்கட்டும் என்று நகுலனைத் தேர்கிறார்; அவர் நடுநிலையால் மகிழ்ந்த யக்ஷன் நால்வரையும் உயிர்ப்பிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: യക്ഷൻ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ട് യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് സൂര്യനെക്കുറിച്ചും ധർമ്മത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും സുഖത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും, ഏറ്റവും വലിയ അത്ഭുതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും, ശരിയായ മാർഗ്ഗത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും നീണ്ട കടംകഥാ ചോദ്യങ്ങൾ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ഓരോന്നിനും മറുപടി നൽകുന്നു. സഹോദരന്മാരിൽ ഒരാളുടെ ജീവൻ നൽകാമെന്ന് യക്ഷൻ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, തന്റെ രണ്ട് അമ്മമാർക്കും ജീവിക്കുന്ന ഒരു പുത്രനുണ്ടാകാൻ അദ്ദേഹം നകുലനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നു; ആ നീതിബോധത്തിൽ സന്തുഷ്ടനായ യക്ഷൻ നാലുപേരെയും ജീവിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.297; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
स ददर्श हतान्भ्रातॄँल्लोकपालानिव च्युतान् ।
युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते शक्रप्रतिमगौरवान् ॥

meaning.en: He saw his brothers lying slain, like world guardians fallen at the end of an age, whose dignity matched Indra's.

verses.text:
विप्रकीर्णधनुर्बाणं दृष्ट्वा निहतमर्जुनम् ।
भीमसेनं यमौ चोभौ निर्विचेष्टान्गतायुषः ॥

meaning.en: He saw Arjuna dead, with bow and arrows scattered, and Bhima and both twins motionless, their lives gone.

verses.text:
स दीर्घमुष्णं निःश्वस्य शोकबाष्पपरिप्लुतः ।
बुद्ध्या विचिन्तयामास वीराः केन निपातिताः ॥

meaning.en: Sighing long and hot, flooded with tears of grief, he thought in his mind: by whom have these heroes been struck down?

verses.text:
नैषां शस्त्रप्रहारोऽस्ति पदं नेहास्ति कस्यचित् ।
भूतं महदिदं मन्ये भ्रातरो येन मे हताः ।
एकाग्रं चिन्तयिष्यामि पीत्वा वेत्स्यामि वा जलम् ॥

meaning.en: There is no wound of any weapon on them and no footprint of anyone here. I think it is some great being that killed my brothers. I will think it over with a steady mind; or I will drink the water and find out.

verses.text:
स्यात्तु दुर्योधनेनेदमुपांशुविहितं कृतम् ।
गान्धारराजरचितं सततं जिह्मबुद्धिना ॥

meaning.en: It might be Duryodhana's secret contrivance, always plotted by the crooked-minded king of Gandhara.

verses.text:
यस्य कार्यमकार्यं वा सममेव भवत्युत ।
कस्तस्य विश्वसेद्वीरो दुर्मतेरकृतात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: To whom doing and not doing what ought to be done are the same, what hero would trust such an evil-minded, undisciplined man?

verses.text:
अथ वा पुरुषैर्गूढैः प्रयोगोऽयं दुरात्मनः ।
भवेदिति महाबाहुर्बहुधा समचिन्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: Or it may be a device of that wicked one by hidden agents; thus the mighty-armed one thought in many ways.

verses.text:
तस्यासीन्न विषेणेदमुदकं दूषितं यथा ।
मुखवर्णाः प्रसन्ना मे भ्रातॄणामित्यचिन्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: But he reflected that this water was not tainted with poison, for his brothers' faces were calm in color.

verses.text:
एकैकशश्चौघबलानिमान्पुरुषसत्तमान् ।
कोऽन्यः प्रतिसमासेत कालान्तकयमादृते ॥

meaning.en: Who else, apart from Time, the End-maker, Yama, could withstand these best of men, each as strong as a flood?

verses.text:
एतेनाध्यवसायेन तत्तोयमवगाढवान् ।
गाहमानश्च तत्तोयमन्तरिक्षात्स शुश्रुवे ॥

meaning.en: With this resolve he stepped into the water; and as he went in, he heard a voice from the sky.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
अहं बकः शैवलमत्स्यभक्षो
मया नीताः प्रेतवशं तवानुजाः ।
त्वं पञ्चमो भविता राजपुत्र
न चेत्प्रश्नान्पृच्छतो व्याकरोषि ॥

meaning.en: I am a crane who feeds on moss and fish; I have brought your younger brothers under the power of death. You will be the fifth, prince, if you do not answer the questions I ask.

verses.text:
मा तात साहसं कार्षीर्मम पूर्वपरिग्रहः ।
प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेय ततः पिब हरस्व च ॥

meaning.en: Do not act rashly, dear child; this is my prior possession. Answer my questions first, son of Kunti, then drink and take water.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
रुद्राणां वा वसूनां वा मरुतां वा प्रधानभाक् ।
पृच्छामि को भवान्देवो नैतच्छकुनिना कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Are you the chief of the Rudras, Vasus or Maruts? I ask who you are, god; this was not done by a bird.

verses.text:
हिमवान्पारियात्रश्च विन्ध्यो मलय एव च ।
चत्वारः पर्वताः केन पातिता भुवि तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: By whose power were the four mountains Himavan, Pariyatra, Vindhya and Malaya laid low on the ground?

verses.text:
अतीव ते महत्कर्म कृतं बलवतां वर ।
यन्न देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरा न च राक्षसाः ।
विषहेरन्महायुद्धे कृतं ते तन्महाद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: You have done a very great deed, best of the mighty; what gods, Gandharvas, Asuras and Rakshasas could not withstand in a great battle you have done, a great wonder.

verses.text:
न ते जानामि यत्कार्यं नाभिजानामि काङ्क्षितम् ।
कौतूहलं महज्जातं साध्वसं चागतं मम ॥

meaning.en: I do not know your purpose or what you want; great curiosity has arisen in me, and dread has come.

verses.text:
येनास्म्युद्विग्नहृदयः समुत्पन्नशिरोज्वरः ।
पृच्छामि भगवंस्तस्मात्को भवानिह तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: My heart is troubled and a fever has risen in my head; therefore I ask, lord, who are you standing here?

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
यक्षोऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते नास्मि पक्षी जलेचरः ।
मयैते निहताः सर्वे भ्रातरस्ते महौजसः ॥

meaning.en: I am a Yaksha, good fortune to you; I am not a water-going bird. It is I who killed all these mighty brothers of yours.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततस्तामशिवां श्रुत्वा वाचं स परुषाक्षराम् ।
यक्षस्य ब्रुवतो राजन्नुपक्रम्य तदा स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those harsh and ill-omened words of the Yaksha, king, he then went forward and stood there.

verses.text:
विरूपाक्षं महाकायं यक्षं तालसमुच्छ्रयम् ।
ज्वलनार्कप्रतीकाशमधृष्यं पर्वतोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: The best of the Bharatas saw the Yaksha, tall as a palm tree, huge, with misshapen eyes, blazing like fire and sun, unassailable, like a mountain.

verses.text:
सेतुमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं ददर्श भरतर्षभः ।
मेघगम्भीरया वाचा तर्जयन्तं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: He stood on the dam, rebuking him in a voice deep as a cloud, a very mighty being.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
इमे ते भ्रातरो राजन्वार्यमाणा मयासकृत् ।
बलात्तोयं जिहीर्षन्तस्ततो वै सूदिता मया ॥

meaning.en: King, these brothers of yours, though I repeatedly forbade them, wished to take the water by force, and so I destroyed them.

verses.text:
न पेयमुदकं राजन्प्राणानिह परीप्सता ।
पार्थ मा साहसं कार्षीर्मम पूर्वपरिग्रहः ।
प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेय ततः पिब हरस्व च ॥

meaning.en: One who wishes to keep his life must not drink this water, king. Partha, do not act rashly; it is my prior possession. Answer my questions, son of Kunti, then drink and take water.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
नैवाहं कामये यक्ष तव पूर्वपरिग्रहम् ।
कामं नैतत्प्रशंसन्ति सन्तो हि पुरुषाः सदा ॥

meaning.en: I do not at all wish to take what is yours by prior claim, Yaksha; good people never praise such a wish.

verses.text:
यदात्मना स्वमात्मानं प्रशंसेत्पुरुषः प्रभो ।
यथाप्रज्ञं तु ते प्रश्नान्प्रतिवक्ष्यामि पृच्छ माम् ॥

meaning.en: When a man praises himself, lord, he does not do well. But I will answer your questions as well as my understanding allows; ask me.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विदादित्यमुन्नयति के च तस्याभितश्चराः ।
कश्चैनमस्तं नयति कस्मिंश्च प्रतितिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: What raises the sun? Who goes about it on all sides? Who makes it set, and in what is it established?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
ब्रह्मादित्यमुन्नयति देवास्तस्याभितश्चराः ।
धर्मश्चास्तं नयति च सत्ये च प्रतितिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Brahman raises the sun, the gods go about it, dharma makes it set, and it is established in truth.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
केन स्विच्छ्रोत्रियो भवति केन स्विद्विन्दते महत् ।
केन द्वितीयवान्भवति राजन्केन च बुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: By what does one become learned in scripture, by what does one attain greatness, by what does one gain a companion, and by what does one become wise, king?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
श्रुतेन श्रोत्रियो भवति तपसा विन्दते महत् ।
धृत्या द्वितीयवान्भवति बुद्धिमान्वृद्धसेवया ॥

meaning.en: By hearing one becomes learned; by austerity one attains greatness; by steadfastness one gains a companion; and by serving elders one becomes wise.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं ब्राह्मणानां देवत्वं कश्च धर्मः सतामिव ।
कश्चैषां मानुषो भावः किमेषामसतामिव ॥

meaning.en: What is the divinity of brahmins, what is their virtue like that of the good, what is their human trait, and what is their ungodly quality?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
स्वाध्याय एषां देवत्वं तप एषां सतामिव ।
मरणं मानुषो भावः परिवादोऽसतामिव ॥

meaning.en: Their divinity is Vedic study; their virtue like the good is austerity; their human trait is death; their ungodly quality is slander.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं क्षत्रियाणां देवत्वं कश्च धर्मः सतामिव ।
कश्चैषां मानुषो भावः किमेषामसतामिव ॥

meaning.en: What is the divinity of kshatriyas, what is their virtue like that of the good, what is their human trait, and what is their ungodly quality?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
इष्वस्त्रमेषां देवत्वं यज्ञ एषां सतामिव ।
भयं वै मानुषो भावः परित्यागोऽसतामिव ॥

meaning.en: Their divinity is the bow and arrow; their virtue like the good is sacrifice; their human trait is fear; their ungodly quality is abandoning those who depend on them.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किमेकं यज्ञियं साम किमेकं यज्ञियं यजुः ।
का चैका वृश्चते यज्ञं कां यज्ञो नातिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: What is the one sacrificial Saman, what is the one sacrificial Yajus, what is the one thing that cuts the sacrifice, and what does the sacrifice never go beyond?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
प्राणो वै यज्ञियं साम मनो वै यज्ञियं यजुः ।
वागेका वृश्चते यज्ञं तां यज्ञो नातिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Breath is the sacrificial Saman, mind is the sacrificial Yajus, speech alone cuts the sacrifice, and the sacrifice does not go beyond speech.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विदापततां श्रेष्ठं किं स्विन्निपततां वरम् ।
किं स्वित्प्रतिष्ठमानानां किं स्वित्प्रवदतां वरम् ॥

meaning.en: What is best of things that fall toward us, what is best of things that fall down, what is best of those who settle, and what is best of those who speak?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
वर्षमापततां श्रेष्ठं बीजं निपततां वरम् ।
गावः प्रतिष्ठमानानां पुत्रः प्रवदतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Rain is best of what comes down on us, seed is best of what is sown, cattle are best of those who settle, and a son is best of those who speak.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
इन्द्रियार्थाननुभवन्बुद्धिमाँल्लोकपूजितः ।
संमतः सर्वभूतानामुच्छ्वसन्को न जीवति ॥

meaning.en: Who, enjoying the objects of the senses, wise, honored by the world and respected by all beings, breathes yet does not live?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
देवतातिथिभृत्यानां पितॄणामात्मनश्च यः ।
न निर्वपति पञ्चानामुच्छ्वसन्न स जीवति ॥

meaning.en: One who makes no offering to the gods, guests, dependents, ancestors, and himself, these five, breathes but does not live.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विद्गुरुतरं भूमेः किं स्विदुच्चतरं च खात् ।
किं स्विच्छीघ्रतरं वायोः किं स्विद्बहुतरं नृणाम् ॥

meaning.en: What is heavier than the earth, what is higher than the sky, what is swifter than the wind, and what is more numerous than men?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
माता गुरुतरा भूमेः पिता उच्चतरश्च खात् ।
मनः शीघ्रतरं वायोश्चिन्ता बहुतरी नृणाम् ॥

meaning.en: A mother is heavier than the earth, a father higher than the sky, the mind swifter than the wind, and worries more numerous than men.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्वित्सुप्तं न निमिषति किं स्विज्जातं न चोपति ।
कस्य स्विद्धृदयं नास्ति किं स्विद्वेगेन वर्धते ॥

meaning.en: What does not close its eyes when asleep, what does not move after being born, what has no heart, and what grows by its speed?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
मत्स्यः सुप्तो न निमिषत्यण्डं जातं न चोपति ।
अश्मनो हृदयं नास्ति नदी वेगेन वर्धते ॥

meaning.en: A fish does not close its eyes when asleep, an egg does not move after being born, a stone has no heart, and a river grows by its speed.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्वित्प्रवसतो मित्रं किं स्विन्मित्रं गृहे सतः ।
आतुरस्य च किं मित्रं किं स्विन्मित्रं मरिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Who is the friend of one who travels abroad, who is the friend of one at home, who is the friend of the sick, and who is the friend of one about to die?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
सार्थः प्रवसतो मित्रं भार्या मित्रं गृहे सतः ।
आतुरस्य भिषङ्मित्रं दानं मित्रं मरिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: A caravan companion is the friend of the traveler, the wife is the friend of one at home, the physician is the friend of the sick, and charity is the friend of the dying.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विदेको विचरति जातः को जायते पुनः ।
किं स्विद्धिमस्य भैषज्यं किं स्विदावपनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: What moves alone, what is born again after being born, what is the remedy for cold, and what is the great field for sowing?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
सूर्य एको विचरति चन्द्रमा जायते पुनः ।
अग्निर्हिमस्य भैषज्यं भूमिरावपनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: The sun moves alone, the moon is born again, fire is the remedy for cold, and the earth is the great field for sowing.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विदेकपदं धर्म्यं किं स्विदेकपदं यशः ।
किं स्विदेकपदं स्वर्ग्यं किं स्विदेकपदं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: What is the one word for what is righteous, the one word for fame, the one word for heaven, and the one word for happiness?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
दाक्ष्यमेकपदं धर्म्यं दानमेकपदं यशः ।
सत्यमेकपदं स्वर्ग्यं शीलमेकपदं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Skill is the one word for the righteous, giving for fame, truth for heaven, and good conduct for happiness.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं स्विदात्मा मनुष्यस्य किं स्विद्दैवकृतः सखा ।
उपजीवनं किं स्विदस्य किं स्विदस्य परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: What is a man's self, what is the friend given by fate, what is his livelihood, and what is his final refuge?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
पुत्र आत्मा मनुष्यस्य भार्या दैवकृतः सखा ।
उपजीवनं च पर्जन्यो दानमस्य परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: A son is a man's self, a wife is the friend given by fate, rain is his livelihood, and giving is his final refuge.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
धन्यानामुत्तमं किं स्विद्धनानां किं स्विदुत्तमम् ।
लाभानामुत्तमं किं स्वित्किं सुखानां तथोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: What is the best of praiseworthy things, what is the best of riches, what is the best of gains, and what is the best of pleasures?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
धन्यानामुत्तमं दाक्ष्यं धनानामुत्तमं श्रुतम् ।
लाभानां श्रेष्ठमारोग्यं सुखानां तुष्टिरुत्तमा ॥

meaning.en: Skill is the best of praiseworthy things, learning is the best of riches, health is the best of gains, and contentment is the best of pleasures.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
कश्च धर्मः परो लोके कश्च धर्मः सदाफलः ।
किं नियम्य न शोचन्ति कैश्च संधिर्न जीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: What is the highest dharma in the world, what dharma always bears fruit, what, when controlled, causes no grief, and with whom does an alliance not decay?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्त्रयीधर्मः सदाफलः ।
मनो यम्य न शोचन्ति सद्भिः संधिर्न जीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: Kindness is the highest dharma, the dharma of the three Vedas always bears fruit, the controlled mind causes no grief, and alliance with the good does not decay.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
किं नु हित्वा प्रियो भवति किं नु हित्वा न शोचति ।
किं नु हित्वार्थवान्भवति किं नु हित्वा सुखी भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Giving up what does one become dear, giving up what does one not grieve, giving up what does one become wealthy, and giving up what does one become happy?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
मानं हित्वा प्रियो भवति क्रोधं हित्वा न शोचति ।
कामं हित्वार्थवान्भवति लोभं हित्वा सुखी भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: By giving up pride one becomes dear, by giving up anger one does not grieve, by giving up desire one becomes wealthy, and by giving up greed one becomes happy.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
मृतः कथं स्यात्पुरुषः कथं राष्ट्रं मृतं भवेत् ।
श्राद्धं मृतं कथं च स्यात्कथं यज्ञो मृतो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: How is a man dead, how is a kingdom dead, how is a funeral rite dead, and how is a sacrifice dead?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
मृतो दरिद्रः पुरुषो मृतं राष्ट्रमराजकम् ।
मृतमश्रोत्रियं श्राद्धं मृतो यज्ञस्त्वदक्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: A poor man is dead, a kingdom without a king is dead, a funeral rite without a learned brahmin is dead, and a sacrifice without a fee is dead.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
का दिक्किमुदकं प्रोक्तं किमन्नं पार्थ किं विषम् ।
श्राद्धस्य कालमाख्याहि ततः पिब हरस्व च ॥

meaning.en: What is the direction, what is water, what is food, Partha, and what is poison? Tell me the time for a funeral rite, then drink and take water.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
सन्तो दिग्जलमाकाशं गौरन्नं प्रार्थना विषम् ।
श्राद्धस्य ब्राह्मणः कालः कथं वा यक्ष मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: The good are the direction, the sky is water, the cow is food, and begging is poison. As for the time for the rite, a brahmin is the time; or how do you see it, Yaksha?

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
व्याख्याता मे त्वया प्रश्ना याथातथ्यं परंतप ।
पुरुषं त्विदानीमाख्याहि यश्च सर्वधनी नरः ॥

meaning.en: You have rightly answered my questions, scorcher of foes. Now tell me who is a true person, and who is a man rich in everything.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
दिवं स्पृशति भूमिं च शब्दः पुण्यस्य कर्मणः ।
यावत्स शब्दो भवति तावत्पुरुष उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: The report of a virtuous deed reaches heaven and earth; as long as that report lasts, so long is he called a person.

verses.text:
तुल्ये प्रियाप्रिये यस्य सुखदुःखे तथैव च ।
अतीतानागते चोभे स वै सर्वधनी नरः ॥

meaning.en: He to whom the pleasant and the unpleasant are the same, and likewise joy and sorrow, and the past and the future both, is indeed a man rich in everything.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
व्याख्यातः पुरुषो राजन्यश्च सर्वधनी नरः ।
तस्मात्तवैको भ्रातॄणां यमिच्छसि स जीवतु ॥

meaning.en: You have explained, king, who is a true person and who is rich in everything. Therefore let one of your brothers, whomever you wish, live.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
श्यामो य एष रक्ताक्षो बृहच्छाल इवोद्गतः ।
व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुर्नकुलो यक्ष जीवतु ॥

meaning.en: This dark one with red eyes, tall like a great sala tree, broad-chested and mighty-armed, Nakula, Yaksha, let him live.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
प्रियस्ते भीमसेनोऽयमर्जुनो वः परायणम् ।
स कस्मान्नकुलं राजन्सापत्नं जीवमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena is dear to you, and Arjuna is your refuge. Why, king, do you want a stepbrother, Nakula, to live?

verses.text:
यस्य नागसहस्रेण दशसंख्येन वै बलम् ।
तुल्यं तं भीममुत्सृज्य नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: Bhima's strength equals that of ten thousand elephants; giving up that Bhima, you want Nakula to live?

verses.text:
तथैनं मनुजाः प्राहुर्भीमसेनं प्रियं तव ।
अथ केनानुभावेन सापत्नं जीवमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: People say Bhimasena is dear to you. By what reasoning do you want a stepbrother to live?

verses.text:
यस्य बाहुबलं सर्वे पाण्डवाः समुपाश्रिताः ।
अर्जुनं तमपाहाय नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: All the Pandavas depend on the strength of Arjuna's arms; leaving Arjuna aside, you want Nakula to live?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मः परमार्थाच्च मे मतम् ।
आनृशंस्यं चिकीर्षामि नकुलो यक्ष जीवतु ॥

meaning.en: Kindness is the highest dharma, and I hold it higher even than the highest gain. I wish to act with kindness; let Nakula live, Yaksha.

verses.text:
धर्मशीलः सदा राजा इति मां मानवा विदुः ।
स्वधर्मान्न चलिष्यामि नकुलो यक्ष जीवतु ॥

meaning.en: Men know me as a king always devoted to dharma; I will not stray from my own dharma. Let Nakula live, Yaksha.

verses.text:
यथा कुन्ती तथा माद्री विशेषो नास्ति मे तयोः ।
मातृभ्यां सममिच्छामि नकुलो यक्ष जीवतु ॥

meaning.en: As Kunti is, so is Madri; I make no difference between them. I want both mothers treated alike; let Nakula live, Yaksha.

verses.text: यक्ष उवाच

meaning.en: The Yaksha said:

verses.text:
यस्य तेऽर्थाच्च कामाच्च आनृशंस्यं परं मतम् ।
तस्मात्ते भ्रातरः सर्वे जीवन्तु भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Since you hold kindness higher than wealth and desire, let all your brothers live, best of Bharatas.
